main.description: The repository's owner likes an app: a star for it, across its releases. It is of the app's listing (com.pipobscure.bundle.listing), and each like comes with a post from the same account saying so. The record key is the sha256 of the listing's at:// address in lowercase hex, so an account has one like of an app; liking it again counts on that record and lists the new post. A like vouches for nothing; nothing installs or refuses by it.

subject.description: The at:// address of the listing of the app liked.

count.description: How many times the account has liked the app. It counts on past the posts listed. Absent, as written by 0.2.0–0.2.1, it is 1.

posts.description: The posts that say so, from the same account, oldest first: one for each like, the newest 100 of them.

post.description: The post that says so, as written by 0.2.0–0.2.1, before likes counted; read as posts: [post]. No longer written.

createdAt.description: When the app was first liked, by the liker's own clock.

updatedAt.description: When it was last liked, by the liker's own clock.
